summary.text: FOX DISTRIBUTION AS is a private limited company registered in Stabekk, founded 2012-08-17. FOX DISTRIBUTION AS sells leisure goods and other products that naturally go together with these, according to its registered activity. Its website Surfshop.no specialises in surfboards, wetsuits and other surf-related products for the Scandinavian market, and carries brands including Xcel, Lost, Channel Islands, Futures fins, FCS and Ocean & Earth. Its main industry code is 47.120: other non-specialised retail sale. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 12 086 932 NOK and the annual result was 82 188 NOK; operating income was up from 10 985 465 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -1 247 009 NOK in 2024 to 82 188 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 231 683 NOK in 2024 to 2 313 871 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is surfshop.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, YouTube profiles. The latest news on its own website is "Surfetur til Maldivene: Åtte dager med bølger, venner og tid til å snakke ferdig" from 2026-10-27. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (254900U184DYV90AOY05). The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
